name: How can I prevent my bathtub drain from clogging in the future?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent my bathtub drain from clogging in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing bathtub clogs involves a few simple habits. Use a drain screen or hair catcher to prevent hair and soap scum from going down the drain. Avoid pouring grease or harsh chemicals into the drain. Regularly flush the drain with hot water to help clear minor buildup. You can also occasionally use a mixture of baking soda and vinegar as a preventative measure. Regular maintenance helps keep drains clear and functioning properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using a drain screen to catch hair, avoiding grease, and regularly flushing with hot water or a baking soda and vinegar solution.
